articles.title: ‘Farewell he truly deserves’: Lionel Messi joins Argentina camp ahead of emotional swansong
articles.summary: Lionel Messi has joined the Argentina squad ahead of what is expected to be his final international appearance on home soil.
articles.body: Lionel Messi has joined the Argentina squad ahead of what is expected to be his final international appearance on home soil. The 39-year-old forward arrived at the team’s Ezeiza training base on Sunday and took part in his first session before the squad gathered for a traditional asado.Argentina will face Benin at the Estadio Monumental on Tuesday, with around 85,000 fans expected to attend the special occasion. The team enters the game in strong form after beating Bolivia 4-0 and Burkina Faso 7-0.Messi will enter the farewell match with an impressive record of 125 goals in 207 appearances for Argentina. His international career includes winning the 2022 World Cup, two Copa America titles and the Finalissima.AFA president Claudio Tapia explained why the federation decided to organise the special event, saying: "We made the decision to invite the best player in the world, the symbol of our national team, our captain, Lionel Andres Messi, so that he can have the farewell he truly deserves on October 6 here in Argentina."Argentina stars set for Messi tributeSeveral of Messi’s long-time teammates will be there for his final appearance. Giovani Lo Celso, Rodrigo De Paul and Nicolas Otamendi are expected to play alongside the Argentina captain.Leandro Paredes will also attend the event from the stands despite serving a 10-match FIFA suspension following the 2026 World Cup final.However, two members of Argentina’s 2022 World Cup-winning squad, Paulo Dybala and Nahuel Molina, will miss the occasion. Their club, AS Roma, did not allow them to travel.Messi’s next chapterArgentina will wear a special one-off kit for the occasion, featuring the Sun of May and laurel branches around Messi’s famous No. 10.After the match, Messi will return his focus to club football with Inter Miami, where he is contracted until the end of the 2028 MLS season.For Argentina coach Lionel Scaloni, the farewell also marks the beginning of a new phase as he looks to develop the next generation of players for the team’s upcoming tournament cycle.Stay updated with the latest Asian Games 2026 news, check the Asian Games medal tally and complete Asian Games schedule.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Uruguay informa de que Martín Satriano regresa a España por "un proceso inflamatorio" en su rodilla
articles.standfirst: El atacante del Getafe estaba ejercitándose con el combinado charrúa a las órdenes de Diego Forlán
articles.summary: El atacante del Getafe estaba ejercitándose con el combinado charrúa a las órdenes de Diego Forlán
articles.body: Malas noticias para el Getafe. Martín Satriano, que estaba estas semanas a las órdenes de Diego Forlán con Uruguay, abandona la concentración charrúa después de que la federación sudamericana informase de un “proceso inflamatorio” en su rodilla. Tras comunicarse la propia federación con el conjunto azulón, ambos decidieron que lo mejor era que el delantero volviera a España para iniciar en el club su proceso de recuperación. Satriano regresaba en esta ventana de selecciones a la lista de la absoluta de su país, aventura que terminará antes de tiempo. El Getafe regresa esta semana a los entrenamientos para un regreso a la competición que trae un choque el sábado frente al FC Barcelona y el debut europeo, la próxima semana, en Rumanía frente al Universitatea Craiova. Bordalás podría perder a un Satriano al que se le seguirán realizando pruebas a su regreso.

articles.title: Vithas renueva como servicio médico oficial del Atlético de Madrid
articles.standfirst: El grupo presta cobertura sanitaria a los jugadores y cuerpo técnico de las primeras plantillas masculina y femenina, así como a sus primeros equipos filiales, desde la temporada 23/24
articles.summary: El grupo presta cobertura sanitaria a los jugadores y cuerpo técnico de las primeras plantillas masculina y femenina, así como a sus primeros equipos filiales, desde la temporada 23/24
articles.body: El Atlético de Madrid ha ampliado su acuerdo con Vithas, que continuará siendo el patrocinador oficial de servicios médicos del club durante la temporada 2026/27. La compañía sanitaria seguirá encargándose de la cobertura médica integral de los futbolistas y cuerpos técnicos de los primeros equipos masculino y femenino, así como de sus respectivos filiales. La relación entre ambas entidades se mantiene desde la campaña 2023/24, cuando Vithas asumió la atención especializada de los equipos rojiblancos a través del Centro de Medicina Deportiva de Alto Rendimiento Vithas/Invictum, ubicado en los hospitales universitarios Vithas Madrid Arturo Soria y Vithas Madrid Aravaca. Óscar Mayo, director general de Ingresos y Operaciones del Atlético de Madrid, valoró muy positivamente la renovación del acuerdo: "Estamos orgullosos de renovar nuestra colaboración con Vithas y seguir creciendo juntos después de tres temporadas. Esta renovación permitirá a nuestros equipos continuar contando con un servicio de salud de máxima calidad asistencial, respaldado por un cuadro médico de reconocido prestigio nacional e internacional". Por parte de Vithas, su CEO, el doctor Pedro Rico, agradeció la confianza depositada por el club madrileño. "Queremos agradecer la confianza que el Club Atlético de Madrid sigue depositando en Vithas y en la experiencia, talento y conocimiento que atesoran nuestros profesionales para atender las necesidades, el rendimiento y la salud de sus jugadores", señaló. Subtítulo: El grupo hospitalario seguirá prestando asistencia médica a los primeros equipos masculino y femenino y a los filiales rojiblancos a través del centro de alto rendimiento Vithas/Invictum.

articles.title: Cristiano Ronaldo has only one personal ambition that could make him swallow his pride and return to Portugal
articles.summary: Cristiano Ronaldo could return to the Portugal national team as he aims for his 1000th career goal. With support from coach Jorge Jesus, the prospect of a final chapter with his country remains alive.
articles.body: Cristiano Ronaldo may have walked away from Portugal, but there is one thing that could make even the greatest player in the country's history swallow his pride and come back.Portugal have already secured their place in the Nations League quarter-finals without their captain, but the focus is now shifting back to a personal ambition Ronaldo has been chasing for years, one that could prove too important to his legacy to simply leave unfinished.Ronaldo's 1000-goal target could still lead him back to PortugalPortuguese journalist Miguel Pereira raised the possibility of a Ronaldo return before Portugal's latest meeting with Norway, when the fallout from his departure was still unfolding and the two sides had yet to play their second match against one another.Speaking to talkSPORT, Pereira argued that Ronaldo had a specific reason for wanting the final stretch of his extraordinary scoring record to involve Portugal, rather than simply completing the milestone during his club career with Al Nassr.“The thing is that 21 goals that he needs to score [to reach his 1000th]. He really wanted to score the last one with Portugal the same way that Pelé mounted a show when he scored his 1000th goal, and I think he was aiming to score that goal at the end of the season in a match with Portugal,” Pereira said.Pereira believed Ronaldo had expected to score around 15 to 20 goals for Al Nassr during the season before creating an occasion around the landmark strike, allowing him to celebrate what would be one of the defining moments of his career in front of the Portuguese supporters.“He was expecting to score the 15-20 goals during the season easily with Al Nassr, but he really wanted to throw up a party that celebrates himself, his ego, his history with the national side,” Pereira added.That possibility looked considerably harder to imagine when Ronaldo left the Portugal camp, although Pereira still believed the relationship could eventually be repaired.Jorge Jesus has now reopened the door for RonaldoPortugal went on to beat Norway 2–1 on Sunday, October 4, at the Estádio do Dragão, giving Jorge Jesus four wins from four in Group A4 and making Portugal the first team to officially secure a place in the Nations League quarter-finals.They achieved that without Ronaldo, who had left the squad after Jesus decided against using him against Norway despite sending him to warm up for around 30 minutes.Jesus has now offered the clearest indication yet that the departure does not have to become permanent, telling reporters after the Norway victory that Ronaldo remains eligible for the next squad selection provided he continues playing and chooses to return.“For me, Cristiano will be eligible for selection the next time the squad is announced, provided he is playing. If he wants to, he will return to the national team,” Jesus said.The Portugal coach also made clear that the final decision rests with Ronaldo, saying: “If he wants to, he'll return to the national team. We can talk before the next call-up, but Cris is the one who's going to decide.”That statement has changed the tone around a possible comeback, particularly because Ronaldo himself has not announced a decision either way since promising that he would explain the reasons for his departure “in due time”.Ronaldo's camp and Portugal still have a way backPereira had argued before the Norway match, that the bridges between Ronaldo's camp and the Portuguese setup could still be rebuilt.“But right now I really do think there are bridges being built between Cristiano’s camp, Jesus’ camp, the Portuguese federation is very much interested in having Cristiano because of all the publicity it gets, and I do think that Cristiano will be back for a last dance with the Portuguese side later next year,” Pereira said.Portugal now have their quarter-final place secured, Jesus has publicly left the decision with Ronaldo, and the forward still has a major personal milestone within reach. The circumstances around his exit remain unresolved, but the possibility of one final Portugal chapter is no longer as difficult to imagine as it was when he walked away.Stay updated with the latest Asian Games 2026 news, check the Asian Games medal tally and complete Asian Games schedule.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Hugo Galdeano, un talento gigante para el Barça
articles.standfirst: El menudo atacante de La Masía brilla por su nivel de juego y su garra… siendo el más chiquito de toda la categoría
articles.summary: El menudo atacante de La Masía brilla por su nivel de juego y su garra… siendo el más chiquito de toda la categoría
articles.body: Con 12 años hay niños que han pegado el ‘estirón’ y otros que lo dejan para un poco más adelante. El caso de Hugo Galdeano, hijo de exfutbolista, es de los que se está cocinando a fuego lento. El más menudo del equipo, pero también del torneo, es el niño con más talento, con bastante diferencia, de los que pisó los campos de la ESPN en Orlando. El Barça tiene en el hijo de Apoño un diamante que reluce con fuerza. El chico tiene regate, disparo, desparpajo a raudales y sobre todo, una visión de juego que es imposible entrenar. Le sale natural. Un pase filtrado, un ligero toque para poner a un compañero en ventaja, un centro medido, una pisada con la cabeza mirando al frente. En definitiva un estilo de juego muy La Masía y bastante reconocible en los mejores jugadores del mundo. “Mi ídolo es Pedri, he aprendido mucho de él y ya le he conocido”, asegura cuando se le pregunta por sus referente. No ha elegido mal jugador al que seguir de cerca. Al margen de la calidad Hugo tiene características, lo necesita. Con su físico, o planta cara y va a todas o a esta edad, con chicos por encima del 1.75 cm tiene poco que hacer. En este último torneo de Orlando se hizo viral un enganchón con un jugador del Betis un par de palmos más grande que él. Acabó con expulsión de un minuto al rincón de pensar. En el aspecto de la popularidad, el chico tampoco se queda corto. Su cuenta de Instagram, obviamente controlada y gestionada por su familia, cuenta con 180.000 seguidores y en ellas se puede comprobar que una multinacional como Nike ya le ha echado el lazo pensando en el futuro que le puede esperar.

articles.title: India vs Uruguay international freindly: When and where to watch - Check match time, telecast and live streaming details
articles.summary: The Indian men's football team will face one of its biggest test of the international window when it takes on two-time FIFA World Cup champions Uruguay at
articles.body: The Indian men's football team will face one of its biggest test of the international window when it takes on two-time FIFA World Cup champions Uruguay at the Vivekananda Yuba Bharati Krirangan in Kolkata on Tuesday. The 7:30 PM IST kick-off will bring the curtain down on a landmark three-match international window for the Blue Tigers, who have already faced Panama and five-time world champions Brazil.India began the window with a resilient 1-1 draw against Panama in Bengaluru before suffering a 0-4 defeat to Brazil in Kolkata. Against Uruguay, Khalid Jamil's side will look to finish the international break with another strong performance against elite opposition.Jamil names 26-member India squadHead coach Khalid Jamil has chosen the following players to represent the Blue Tigers for this high-profile international window:Goalkeepers: Gurpreet Singh Sandhu, Prabhsukhan Singh Gill, Amrinder Singh, Albino GomesDefenders: Anwar Ali, Akash Mishra, Sandesh Jhingan, Rahul Bheke, Nikhil Poojary, Naocha Singh, Jay Gupta, ValpuiaMidfielders: Anirudh Thapa, Sahal Abdul Samad, Jeakson Singh, Suresh Singh Wangjam, Apuia Ralte, Liston Colaco, Brandon Fernandes, Lallianzuala Chhangte, Naorem Mahesh Singh, Imran KhanForwards: Manvir Singh, Vikram Partap Singh, Ryan Williams, Mohammed SananWhen and where to watch India vs UruguayThe India vs Uruguay international friendly will be played on Tuesday, October 6, 2026, at the Vivekananda Yuba Bharati Krirangan (Salt Lake Stadium) in Kolkata.The match will kick off at 7:30 PM IST.In India, the game will be broadcast live on Sony Sports Ten 2 SD & HD, Sony Aath SD & HD (Bengali), Sony Sports Ten 3 Hindi SD & HD, Sony Sports Ten 4 (Tamil, Telugu, Kannada) & Sony LIV.India vs Uruguay: A night of another heavyweight challengeFor Indian football, the fixture represents more than just another friendly.
